body: A skill only fires when the agent judges it relevant. Proposal: (1) add the words agents see in prompts (tickets, backlog, TODO, track work, resume) to the SKILL.md description; (2) have setup print a two-line stanza for the host's AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md telling agents to use gittoc for all task tracking. Owner decision whether setup should also offer to append it.
title: adoption: trigger words in SKILL.md description; setup prints an AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md stanza
